name: output-trimmer
description: When a Bash command prints too much, the model gets only the head, the tail and the error lines; the full output is saved to a file

max_lines.title: Trim after this many lines
max_lines.description: When Bash output has more lines than this, the model gets only the head, the tail and the error lines.

max_chars.title: Trim after this many characters
max_chars.description: The same when Bash output has more characters than this.
